what.text: This page follows refugees from Burkina Faso living in Mali.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 200771 in Mali, 57.2% of all refugees from Burkina Faso and more than in any other host country.
Côte d'Ivoire and Togo host the next largest numbers.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Burkina Faso with JNIM from 2018 to 2025, at war level from 2022.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2019 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's figure for Mali rose from 93445 at the end of 2024 to 200771 at the end of 2025, its highest.
The figure also changed sharply between 2019 and 2020, between 2021 and 2022 and in each year since 2023, in the same years as the conflicts UCDP records.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in Mali only.
Gender and age are known for only part of this group.
The sources don't say which routes people took or where in Mali they live.
